events.title: Jean Sammet develops FORMAC
events.summary: Jean Sammet created FORMAC in 1962 — one of the first languages for symbolic mathematics on computers.
events.about: Sammet also edited Programming Languages: History and Fundamentals — the standard reference for language historians. Her FORMAC work showed computers could manipulate algebra, not just arithmetic.

narrative.whyChosen: Sammet bridged symbolic math and programming language design.
narrative.whyImportant: She documented the entire early language landscape for later researchers.
narrative.problemSolved: Scientists needed automated symbolic manipulation beyond numeric FORTRAN.
